meta.docSubtitle: Scoping supplement for your MuleSoft engagement
meta.source: Discovery session with Acme Corp team (May 12, 2026)

bizContext.snapshot: Acme Corp is a mid-market specialty retailer with 280 locations across 14 states, running Salesforce for CRM and NetSuite for ERP. The sales team closes deals in Salesforce, but order fulfillment, inventory visibility, and invoicing all live in NetSuite — creating a data gap that forces ops to manually reconcile both systems daily.

journeyCards.label: Connected
journeyCards.headline: Order-to-Fulfillment Without Manual Handoffs
journeyCards.body: Closed Salesforce opportunities trigger order creation in NetSuite automatically. Inventory availability and shipment status flow back into Salesforce so reps stop calling ops for updates.

journeyCards.label: Automated
journeyCards.headline: Demand-Driven Inventory Alerts
journeyCards.body: With live pipeline data and inventory in one place, automated alerts fire when open opportunity demand exceeds available stock — giving procurement a 3-week lead time instead of reactive scrambling.

journeyCards.label: Agentic
journeyCards.headline: AI-Powered Reorder Optimization
journeyCards.body: An AI agent reads closed-won velocity, current stock levels, and supplier lead times to recommend optimal reorder quantities per SKU — reducing both overstock carrying costs and stockout-driven lost sales.

p0Blockers.title: NetSuite REST API Access
p0Blockers.body: NetSuite REST API requires a custom integration record + OAuth 2.0 setup by a NetSuite admin. Must be completed before any architecture work. Owner: Acme IT (Jason Park).

p0Blockers.title: Salesforce Connected App
p0Blockers.body: A Connected App for JWT server-to-server OAuth must be created in the Salesforce org before integration testing can begin. Owner: Salesforce admin (TBD).

sections.title: Use Cases
sections.bodyHtml:
UC-1

Salesforce Opportunity → NetSuite Sales Order (Event-Driven)

▼

Triggered when a Salesforce Opportunity reaches Closed-Won. Creates a NetSuite Sales Order from the opportunity line items. NS Order ID written back to Salesforce as an external reference field.

Which Salesforce Opportunity Stage value should trigger order creation in NetSuite? "Closed Won" was referenced in sessions — confirm the exact picklist value. *
Closed Won Approved — different value
If a NetSuite Sales Order already exists for an Opportunity (re-trigger scenario), what should happen? *
Skip — leave existing NS order unchanged Update existing order Create a new order regardless
Which Salesforce fields should be updated after the NetSuite order is created (sync-back)?
From sessions: NS Order ID, order status, and estimated ship date were mentioned. Confirm or add fields.
In ScopeEvent-driven Opp→Order creation; NS Order ID written back to Salesforce; line item mapping from Opportunity Products
Assumed Pre-ExistsNetSuite Customer records match Salesforce Accounts by name; NS_Order_ID__c external ID field created before dev starts
Out of ScopeCreating NetSuite Customer records from Salesforce Accounts; credit checks or order approval workflows
UC-2

NetSuite Inventory → Salesforce (Scheduled Nightly)

▼

Nightly pull of NetSuite inventory levels (quantity on hand, committed, available) into a Salesforce Inventory custom object. Enables sales reps to check stock without leaving Salesforce.

What is the desired sync schedule for the nightly inventory pull? *
Once nightly (2 AM local) Twice daily Real-time webhook from NS
Should this sync cover ALL NetSuite inventory items, or only items in specific subsidiaries, locations, or item classes? *
All inventory items Filter by location or class — specify below
Has the Salesforce Inventory custom object (Inventory__c) already been created, or does Acme IT need to build it before development starts?
DataSkate will provide a field specification document if the object needs to be created.
Already exists in Salesforce Not yet — please send field spec Unknown
In ScopeNightly NS inventory pull; upsert by SKU into Salesforce Inventory__c; QOH, committed, available fields
Assumed Pre-ExistsSalesforce Inventory__c with SKU__c as External ID; NetSuite REST API OAuth configured
Out of ScopeWriting inventory adjustments back to NetSuite from Salesforce; cost/valuation fields

internalFlags.bodyHtml:
1
Auth model: Salesforce = OAuth JWT (service account). NetSuite = OAuth 2.0 with token-based auth (TBA). NS Consumer Key/Secret + Token ID/Secret stored in CloudHub Secrets Manager.
2
P0 gate: Both P0 blockers (NS REST API access + SF Connected App) must be confirmed resolved before architecture kickoff. If either is unresolved at requirements start, project timeline slips.
3
NS upsert key: Use externalId (Salesforce Opportunity ID) on the NetSuite Sales Order to prevent duplicate creation on re-trigger. NS supports externalId as a upsert key on SalesOrder records.
